cohort: A cohort of 36 women, aged 20-35 years (average 24.38), consisting of primiparous and multiparous individuals from urban and rural areas, were studied in the first days after birth, with 18 having natural birth and 18 having a cesarean section.
finding: Normal birth appears to be much more beneficial for the mother (physically, mentally, independence, and recovery) and for the child (Apgar score) compared to caesarian section.
mod_finding: Normal birth appears more beneficial for the mother (physically, mentally, independence, recovery) and the child (Apgar score) compared to cesarean section.
